Crossing Minds co-founder Alexandre Robicquet has updated his LinkedIn job history to "OpenAI's Research, Post-training and Agents." This is a sign that OpenAI intends to utilize their recommendation algorithms for "behavioral optimization of conversational AI" and "personalized support by agents."

Since early 2025, OpenAI has been introducing recommendation features for product suggestions, reviews, and images into ChatGPT, and Crossing Minds' technology has the potential to contribute to the advancement of the "decision-making engine" that supports these features.

Until now, OpenAI has been advancing the development of highly versatile models, but from here on, strengthening the agent domain—which is "personalized support" tailored to the user's context—will become important. In that regard, high-precision, high-efficiency recommendation technology honed in e-commerce will become a weapon.
The fact that Crossing Minds held the value of "achieving personalization while protecting privacy" also aligns with OpenAI's mission of "AI that benefits all of humanity."
